f.title: Use the DHPC template also for a core EU DHPC
f.statement: The template should also be used for the preparation of a core EU DHPC (see GVP Module XV, XV.C.2.1.).
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), cover note
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

rows.quote:

f.title: Address the DHPC from the MAH, in agreement with the EMA and/or the national competent authority
f.statement: The DHPC is dated, carries a title giving the active substance, name of the medicinal product and main message (e.g. introduction of a warning or contraindication), is addressed to healthcare professionals, and states that the marketing authorisation holder informs them in agreement with the European Medicines Agency and/or the national competent authority.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), heading and opening
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

rows.quote:
<Date>


<Active substance, name of medicinal product and main message (e.g.
introduction of a warning or a contraindication)>

Dear Healthcare professional,

<Name of marketing authorisation holder> in agreement with <the European Medicines Agency> and
the <National Competent Authority > would like to inform you of the following:

f.title: Put the summary in bold or larger font, preferably as bullet points
f.statement: The Summary section should be in bold or a larger font size than the other sections of the DHPC and preferably in bullet points.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Summary
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

f.title: Summarise the safety concern, risk minimisation recommendations and any switch to alternative treatment
f.statement: The Summary gives a brief description of the safety concern in the context of the therapeutic indication, recommendations for risk minimisation (e.g. contraindications, warnings, precautions of use) and, if applicable, switch to alternative treatment.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Summary
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

f.title: Include recall information, with recall level and date, when applicable
f.statement: If applicable, the Summary includes recall information, including the level (pharmacy or patient) and the date of the recall.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Summary
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

rows.quote: <Recall information, if applicable, including level (pharmacy or patient) and date of recall>

rows.review_note: Review: template placeholder text read as the expected content of a DHPC; level Recommended because the template carries no shall/must and GVP Module XV gives the duty to use it. Double-check: quote proves statement.

f.title: Give background on the safety concern: indication, adverse reaction details, frequency, off-label link and risk minimisation
f.statement: The Background section may include: a brief description of the therapeutic indication; important details about the safety concern (adverse reaction, seriousness, statement on the suspected causal relationship and, if known, the pharmacodynamic mechanism, temporal relationship, positive re-challenge or de-challenge, risk factors); an estimate of the frequency of the adverse reaction or reporting rates with estimated patient exposure; any association with off-label use; and details on the recommendations for risk minimisation.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Background on the safety concern
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

rows.quote:
Guidance: This section may include the following information:

<Brief description of the therapeutic indication of the medicinal product>

<Important details about the safety concern (adverse reaction, seriousness, statement on the
suspected causal relationship, and, if known, the pharmacodynamic mechanism, temporal relationship,
positive re-challenge or de-challenge, risk factors)>

<An estimation of the frequency of the adverse reaction or reporting rates with estimated patient
exposure>

<A statement indicating any association between the adverse reaction and off-label use, if applicable>

<If applicable, details on the recommendations for risk minimisation>

f.title: State whether the product information is being revised; the translated text need not be attached
f.statement: The Background may state whether the product information is to be or has been revised, with a description of the changes made or proposed. There is no need to include or attach the precise (translated) text of the product information, which may not be available as final approved translations when the DHPC is disseminated.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Background on the safety concern
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

as final approved translations)

f.title: Place the risk in the benefit context and explain timing, evidence, previous DHPCs and follow-up actions
f.statement: The Background may also give the place of the risk in the context of the benefit; the reason for disseminating the DHPC at this point in time; any evidence supporting the recommendation (e.g. citations of key studies); a statement on previous DHPCs recently disseminated on the same safety concern; and any schedule for follow-up action(s) by the marketing authorisation holder or competent authority.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Background on the safety concern
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

f.title: Remind healthcare professionals to report adverse reactions and how to reach the national reporting system
f.statement: The Call for reporting reminds healthcare professionals of the need to report adverse reactions, and how, in accordance with the national spontaneous reporting system, including details (e.g. name, postal address, fax number, website address) on how to access it.
f.clause: GVP Annex II - Template: Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (Rev 1), Call for reporting
f.applicability: Direct healthcare professional communications (DHPCs) in the EU, including core EU DHPCs

f.statement: The DHPC gives company contact point details for access to further information, including relevant website address(es), telephone numbers and a postal address.

f.statement: If applicable, annexes may give links or references to other relevant information (such as a competent authority website), additional scientific information, and a list of literature references.
